qualification_basis: Root authoritative precision delivered by courier; preserve all existing clock bytes. Literal inclusive Phase2 begins at immutable Phase1 judgment lock, including key-release wait and all report/handoff work.
recorded_phase2_start_scope: Actual first key/metadata checking clock only, not the literal inclusive Phase2 clock. No saved artifact is rewritten.
phase2_report_elapsed_field_scope: phase2_elapsed_at_report_write_seconds is the actual key/checking interval; literal inclusive interval additionally charges the Phase1 lock-to-checking wait. clock-closure.json will expose both.
